newsitem.title: USA: Nextwave IPO still not firmly scheduled - Merrill.
newsitem.headline: Nextwave IPO still not firmly scheduled - Merrill.

text.p: The initial public offering of Nextwave Telecom Inc still has yet to be firmly scheduled, according to lead underwriter Merrill Lynch & Co on Monday.
Nextwave filed in June for a $300 million IPO of Class B common stock under the proposed symbol "SURF".
NextWave also filed for a $400 million offering of senior discount notes due 2006 in June which has not yet been completed.

The company said early Monday it is in a pact with Lucent Technologies Inc and MCI Communications to test Lucent's Personal Communications Services (PCS) equipment. The companies have begun field trials of digital mobile services and have installed a PCS demonstration system at MCI's headquarters in Washington D.C.
